purpose: Block-scale sensitivity check for the headline z_boot ≈ -18.1 exclusion. Requested by R29 reviewers (Claude E01, OpenAI E5, OpenAI M10). Tests NSIDE_block ∈ {4, 8, 16} with N_boot=500 each. Catalog: bamfai/galaxy-chirality-catalog catalog_production.parquet (3,201,160 spirals). Design: same 9-template WLS as joint_nuisance_bootstrap_sigma.py.
interpretation: The headline z_boot ≈ -18.1 exclusion is stable across all three block scales. Range: z ∈ [-19.4, -16.9] across NSIDE ∈ {4, 8, 16}. The NSIDE=8 value (-18.4) lies between the two extremes, confirming it is not a pessimistic outlier. The single-scale brittleness concern (R29 E01) is resolved: the exclusion survives under any plausible block-scale choice. The 14.7× inflation factor at NSIDE=8 remains representative (range 13.7×–15.7×).
